ex.en: The customs of the village seemed alien to the young reporter.
ex.zh: 这个村庄的习俗对年轻记者来说很陌生。

words.note: be alien to sb 表「对某人陌生」；作名词指外侨或外星人。

ex.en: The interview tested her competence in handling difficult customers.
ex.zh: 面试考察了她应对难缠顾客的能力。

words.note: 名词，形容词 competent，be competent in/at 擅长。

ex.en: The lights went out when a sudden surge of power blew the fuse.
ex.zh: 电流突然激增烧断了保险丝，灯都灭了。

words.note: blow a fuse 字面指保险丝熔断，口语表「大发脾气」。

ex.en: The scholarship gives talented students from poor areas a chance to join the elite.
ex.zh: 这项奖学金让贫困地区的优秀学生有机会进入精英行列。

words.note: 集合名词，谓语可用单数或复数；elitist 精英主义的。

ex.en: Good housing is at a premium in the centre of the city.
ex.zh: 市中心的优质住房非常稀缺。

words.note: at a premium 表「稀缺、溢价」；作形容词指优质的。

ex.en: The hall was ornamented with flowers and coloured lights for the wedding.
ex.zh: 大厅用鲜花和彩灯装饰，用于婚礼。

words.note: 作名词指装饰品，作动词表装饰，常用 be ornamented with。

ex.en: The doctor assured her that the test results were completely normal.
ex.zh: 医生向她保证检查结果完全正常。

words.note: assure 后接人；ensure 后接事，如 ensure safety。

ex.en: He left the meeting early on the pretext of an urgent phone call.
ex.zh: 他以有紧急电话为借口提前离开了会议。

words.note: on the pretext of doing 表「以…为借口」，多指借口不实。

ex.en: The ban on the ivory trade helped protect wild elephants.
ex.zh: 禁止象牙贸易帮助保护了野生大象。

words.note: ivory tower（象牙塔）指脱离现实的环境或学术生活。

ex.en: The theme of the conference is how cities can save energy.
ex.zh: 会议的主题是城市如何节约能源。

words.note: 比 topic 更强调贯穿全篇的中心思想；形容词 thematic。

ex.en: You should consult a doctor before taking these tablets.
ex.zh: 服用这些药片前你应该咨询医生。

words.note: consult a dictionary 查阅；consult with sb 商议。

ex.en: Workers marched to show solidarity with the striking miners.
ex.zh: 工人们游行，声援罢工的矿工。

words.note: 不可数，常与 with 连用，表「声援、团结一致」。

ex.en: The little boy tumbled down the last few steps and started crying.
ex.zh: 小男孩从最后几级台阶上摔了下来，哭了起来。

words.note: 指踉跄摔倒或翻滚；tumble down 也指建筑物倒塌。

ex.en: Our host was gracious enough to drive us to the station.
ex.zh: 主人很客气，开车把我们送到车站。

words.note: 表亲切有礼，多形容主人或举止；与 graceful 优雅区分。

ex.en: The ball smashed through the kitchen window and landed on the floor.
ex.zh: 球砸穿厨房窗户，落在地板上。

words.note: smash hit 表轰动的成功；smash 强调猛烈撞击致碎。

ex.en: He was not merely late; he had forgotten the tickets entirely.
ex.zh: 他不仅迟到了，还完全忘了带票。

words.note: 相当于 only，但更书面；not merely...but also 常见。

ex.en: The council approved an appropriation of funds for road repairs.
ex.zh: 议会批准了用于修路的资金拨款。

words.note: 作动词表「挪用、拨出」；名词 appropriation。

ex.en: There is a clear contradiction between his words and his actions.
ex.zh: 他的言行之间存在明显矛盾。

words.note: 常用 between A and B；形容词 contradictory。

ex.en: A wealth of information is available on the museum's website.
ex.zh: 博物馆网站上提供大量信息。

words.note: a wealth of 表「大量的」，后接不可数或复数名词。

ex.en: The rule will henceforth apply to all students in the department.
ex.zh: 该规定从此将适用于系里所有学生。

words.note: 较正式，常见于法律或公告，相当于 from now on。

ex.en: He found a wallet on the bus and handed it to the driver.
ex.zh: 他在公交车上捡到一个钱包，交给了司机。

words.note: 指男士折叠皮夹；女用钱包常说 purse。

ex.en: Only two passengers survived the crash, according to the report.
ex.zh: 据报道，只有两名乘客在这次撞车事故中幸存。

words.note: survive 后直接跟宾语；survivor 是「幸存者」。

ex.en: She had a strong desire to study abroad after graduation.
ex.zh: 毕业后她强烈渴望出国留学。

words.note: 比 want 正式；leave much to be desired 表有很多不足。

ex.en: My initial reaction to the news was one of complete disbelief.
ex.zh: 我对这个消息的最初反应是完全不敢相信。

words.note: 作名词时复数 initials 指姓名首字母；动词 initiate。

ex.en: The new heating system is far more efficient than the old one.
ex.zh: 新的供暖系统比旧的效率高得多。

words.note: efficient 指效率高，effective 指有效果，注意区分。

ex.en: She murmured a few words of comfort and held his hand.
ex.zh: 她低声说了几句安慰的话，握住他的手。

words.note: 指低声连续地说；heart murmur 指心脏杂音。

ex.en: He slammed the door in a fury and refused to speak to anyone.
ex.zh: 他怒气冲冲地摔上门，拒绝和任何人说话。

words.note: furious 是形容词；in a fury 表「怒气冲冲地」。

ex.en: The new leader promised to unify the divided country within a year.
ex.zh: 新领导人承诺一年内统一这个分裂的国家。

words.note: uni-（一）+ -fy（使…）→ 使统一；名词 unity。

ex.en: The children came home with muddy boots and wet jackets.
ex.zh: 孩子们回家时靴子沾满泥，夹克也湿了。

words.note: mud 的形容词，也比喻「含糊不清的」，如 muddy thinking。

ex.en: The actor was hounded by reporters for weeks after the scandal.
ex.zh: 丑闻之后，这位演员被记者纠缠了好几周。

words.note: 作名词指猎犬，作动词表「不断纠缠」，常用于被动。
